title: Update a while condition from a function
description: You follow the supplied rain-check function and its effect on the loop condition.

steps.description: You import random and define checkIfRaining to return True. raining begins as False.
You enter the loop while not raining holds. Its body draws a random value, computes minutes, and formats a message.

steps.question: What value does the supplied checkIfRaining assign to raining?
steps.answer: It returns True. The next test of not raining is therefore false.

steps.description: You update the condition variable at the end of the body. The recording contains one message from the loop before it ends.
